static_traits.name: 张宁
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and younger sister
static_traits.social_status: 有少数亲密朋友，但并not yet向他们倾诉当前困扰；在Interpersonal relationships的建立与维持上因担心被评判而受影响
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 配合度较高、态度积极；表达清晰、思路连贯；能描述主观感受与自动化思维；情绪呈紧张与not堪负荷；易受他人评价影响

basic_info.main_problem: 我在昨天从滑板上摔下来后一直觉得自己是个失败者和一个糟糕的Athlete，这trigger了自我not足和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: These negative thoughts are affecting my self-esteem and overall mood, making it hard for me to concentrate on my studies, so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: 在学校被同伴称为“懒鬼”和“怪人”，负面标签化经历持续存在并反复trigger自我not足与Self-doubt；每当犯错或收到关于外貌与兴趣的负面评论时，这些感受就卷土重来；随之在人际上更难建立和维持友谊，并逐渐减少自我揭露与求助。
尽管在考试前十分紧张，过去曾在多次考试中取得好成绩；这些成功显示其具备能力与韧性，但在Low mood时难以提取并稳定保持对自身能力的正向认知。

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在运动中摔倒或犯错，就证明我整体上是失败者和糟糕的Athlete
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Displacement注意力到其他爱好、降低挑战难度、避免在他人面前练习以减少再次失败的风险
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 一次摔倒就说明我not行/I am a failure

special_situations.event: 在学校被同伴称为“懒鬼”“怪人”
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人用负面标签评价我，就说明I am not good enough、not值得被接纳
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to ignore comments and reduces in-depth socializing and self-disclosure to avoid further evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们说的是真的，我not被接纳

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要出现错误，就意味着我永远not够好，not yet来也会一直失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Chooses simpler tasks, avoids high-difficulty challenges to reduce the probability of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会一直失败，我永远not够好

special_situations.event: 收到关于外貌或兴趣的负面评论
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的外貌或兴趣not被认可，就说明我有问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hides interests, reduces expression and socializing to avoid attention and negative evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 大家都在看not起我/他们会持续贬低我

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被同伴接纳、被尊重与认可，能力被看见
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被羞辱与被评判为失败者，害怕暴露自我后Being rejected与伤害
defense_goal: 通过减少自我揭露与回避挑战来维持安全感
将注意力转向爱好以降低情绪冲击
先行自我贬低与贴标签以降低他人negate带来的打击

object_relations.self_representation: 被评判的失败者/not够好的Student
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔与贬低的同伴/评判者
潜在支持者但not一定可信赖的朋友

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor further explores the specific details of being labeled by peers and present feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously believes that talking about it in detail will invite judgment or humiliation, and needs to suppress emotions to avoid being hurt
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和、放慢速度、允许停顿；鼓励情绪标注与具体化，但避免逼迫，use支持性反映与正常化以降低羞耻。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes conducting behavioral experiments or gradual exposure to test negative beliefs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将咨询师的提议理解为对能力的评判，担心失败后被negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 承认来访者的担忧，use归纳式Questioning区分“证据”与“解释”，共同设定微小、可控的尝试；语气鼓励、not过度推动。

manifestations: 持续感到被同伴评判与疏离
日常活动与自我照料减少

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对其他人或物做出某个行为的冲动，或放弃向外寻求do not人为其做某事，转而对自己做，即个体将原欲对外发出的能量转而对自己。
manifestations: 选择“忍着”，not向朋友寻求支持
把强烈情绪往内收，通过分散注意来应对

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: When talking about negative comments, tries to brush past them and quickly shifts to a narrative of 'focusing on hobbies'
use笼统语句淡化具体细节

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently labeling oneself as a 'failure'“not够好”
过度在意他人评价，谨慎表达自己的兴趣与观点

exception_events.target_problem: 在考试或被评价的情境下，来访者通常会因Anxiety与Self-doubt而难以专注与发挥，随后Self-denial加剧。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在某些考试中（此前几次重要测试），来访者虽然非常紧张，但仍完成考试并取得了好成绩，与以往“I will fail”的自我叙事not同。
exception_events.reason: 线索：在当次考试中，尽管紧张，仍选择专注于题目、持续作答（做法not同）；将紧张视为可承受的状态（not同理解），因此表现更稳定。

positive_force: Has achieved good exam results under tension, showing a certain ability and resilience
态度积极，愿意寻求帮助并尝试小步行动
Has interests and hobbies to invest in, which can serve as resources for emotion regulation and recovery
具备一定的自我观察能力，能识do not负性自动思维
negative_force: 过度在意他人评价，依赖外部验证以判断自我价值
过度概括、预测not yet来、读心等认知歪曲ReinforcementSelf-denial
Impaired self-esteem导致学习专注与日常Decreased motivation
Social avoidance与not自我揭露，阻断潜在支持

target_behavior.behavior: 自我贴标签与过度概括的负性自动化思维（如“I am a failure”“我是糟糕的Athlete”）
antecedent: 被他人以外貌或兴趣进行负面评论
处在被评价或考试的情境
target_behavior.core_reason: 被同伴负面标签化经历削弱自我概念，加之认知歪曲（过度概括、读心、预测not yet来、情绪化推理）使单次失误被当作全局证据
target_behavior.function: Avoids higher-difficulty challenges and external evaluation to reduce the risk of further failure or shame
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、学习专注下降、整体Low mood

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance与not向朋友倾诉困扰
antecedent: 经历负面标签后的人际接触情境
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被羞辱与拒绝，内在客体关系将他人视为评判者，导致Withdrawal
target_behavior.function: 避免负面评价以维持短期安全与可控感
target_behavior.consequence: 难以建立和维持友谊，Loneliness感上升，支持系统not yet被充分利用

target_behavior.behavior: Decreased motivation与自我照料减少（学习与日常活动参与度降低）
antecedent: 经历负性自我评价之后
target_behavior.core_reason: Emotional reasoning and 'black-and-white' thinking lead to negative beliefs about the usefulness of effort
target_behavior.function: 通过减少投入来暂时缓解压力与失败恐惧
target_behavior.consequence: Declining academic performance、生活质量降低、负性循环加剧
